title: Concept: Shell invoked explicitly from exec.Command in go — review required
description: In go, the process is started through sh -c. Go avoids the shell by default, which is why this pattern is a reliable marker of an intentional shell step; the value that follows -c is parsed with all shell metacharacters active.
applicability: go services and jobs that run pipeline commands.
risk: Shell injection with process privileges; HIGH severity.
